Lia and Alex

Lia and Alex: an AI to go fast, a human for everything else

Lia is a tool. Alex is a person. Lia makes small and medium changes to your website in 5 minutes. Alex does the rest, by hand, and answers when you need someone.

Lia, the AI

In 5 minutes, for small and medium changes

  • Changes a text, opening hours, a displayed price, a sentence
  • Adds or replaces a photo, publishes a news item
  • Works on a single page per request
  • Always shows you a preview of the page before changing anything
  • Hands over to Alex as soon as it is too big or unclear

Alex, the human

By hand, for everything that matters

  • Creates your website and registers your domain name
  • Connects the website, installs the SSL certificate (the padlock) and the hosting
  • Takes care of SEO and updates
  • Makes the big changes: new page, redesign, shop
  • Sets up Lia, and answers you in person

I really am here

My name is Alex, and there really is someone behind this website. I am the one who builds your website, puts it online and is responsible for it. When you write, I am the one who reads it.

Lia does not replace me. She saves me time on the small things, so I have more for the rest: your SEO, your new pages, your questions. This mix is what keeps prices low without leaving you alone with a machine.

Lia, what exactly is she?

Lia is an AI set up specially for the websites I build. She runs on a professional AI model from a specialist company, which I have configured with my own rules: what she is allowed to do, what she must refuse, and how she must show you her work.

She is not a person and she is not a developer. She can help you, quickly and well, with simple changes. She does not replace a human, and she does not pretend to.

What Lia can do in one request

Lia has a budget, so she sticks to small and medium changes:

  • Text only: up to 300 words.
  • Text and one photo: up to 200 words.
  • Text and two photos: up to 100 words.
  • Mostly photos: up to 3 photos, with a short caption.

The more photos, the less text, and the other way round. All on a single page.

Beyond that, the request goes to Alex. It takes longer, because it is done by hand, and it takes the place of your monthly change by Alex.

Always a preview, never a surprise

Lia never changes your website directly. She prepares the change, then shows you the page as it will look. You take a look, and you choose:

  1. That’s right: the change goes live.
  2. That’s not it: nothing changes, and Alex takes over the request.

You are the one who approves: once you say yes, the change is live, with no waiting for anyone. It all takes about 5 minutes.

Cancel a request

Changed your mind? You can cancel a request free of charge within 24 hours, from your client area, up to 3 times a month. It then does not count towards your changes for the month, and if Lia had already put it live, the page goes back to how it was. Beyond that, write to me and we will look at it together.

Limits, for your safety

Lia is configured to stay careful:

  • She cannot delete a page.
  • She does not touch the theme, the plugins or the accounts.
  • She does not change the prices of an online shop.
  • She does not rewrite your legal texts (legal notice, terms of sale).
  • She only acts on your website, through a secure connection, and every action is logged.
  • The previous state is kept: we can always go back.

If a request is unclear, she does not guess: she passes it to me.

Why it is included in the subscription

Every request to Lia uses computing power, which I am billed for by usage. I chose to include it in the subscription, as Lia Tokens, for your comfort: you have nothing to pay to another company, no settings to adjust, no complicated connection to install. You write your request, and that is all.

How many changes a month?

With the subscription, you get 100 Lia Tokens and one change by Alex every month. The two counters are separate, and they reset on the 1st of the month.

What are Lia Tokens for?

One Lia Token is worth 1 cent. Your tokens are used for two things: changes to your website by Lia, and the tools in your client area (posting on social media, correcting or translating a text, advice on a photo or a page). A change made by Lia costs 30 tokens, plus 1 token for every 10 words written in your request, plus 10 tokens per attached photo. That is about 30 to 65 tokens. So your 100 tokens a month make 2 to 3 changes by Lia. If you prefer the tools, count on about ten uses. If Lia passes your request on to Alex, your tokens are given back to you.

Need more?

Lia + is an extra: it adds 500 Lia Tokens to your month, for €5 more. You add it or remove it whenever you like, from your client area. A top-up is bought one at a time: 100 tokens for €1, 500 for €5, 1000 for €10, on your next invoice. Those tokens are not wiped at the end of the month. The Boost is for Alex: one more change on top of your monthly one, for €5.

Your questions about Lia and Alex

Can Lia break my website?

No. She cannot delete a page, or touch the theme, the plugins, the accounts or a shop’s prices. Every change is first prepared in a preview, which you approve. And the previous state is kept: Alex can go back.

What happens if my request is too big for Lia?

Lia touches nothing and passes the request to Alex. It takes longer, since it is done by hand, and it then counts as your monthly change by Alex. The tokens for that request are given back to you.

Do my Lia Tokens and my changes by Alex add up?

No, each is counted on its own. Lia Tokens pay for what Lia does: changes to your website and the tools in your client area. The change by Alex has its own counter. One does not turn into the other. Everything comes back every month, and anything unused does not carry over to the next month. Only the tokens from a top-up stay until you have spent them.

Do I need to pay for an AI myself?

No. Lia is included in your Alex & Lia subscription: no account to create elsewhere, no settings to adjust, no connection to install. You write your request, that is all.

Can I cancel a request?

Yes, free of charge within 24 hours of sending it, up to 3 times a month, from your client area. The request then no longer counts in your month, and its tokens go back to your account. Beyond that, write to Alex.

Can I do without Lia?

Yes. For each request, you choose Lia or Alex. If you prefer everything done by hand, always choose Alex.
